description:
About the role

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer with strong experience in Python and PostgreSQL. You will build REST APIs using FastAPI and deploy with Docker. Experience with Kubernetes is a plus.

You should have excellent communication skills and the ability to work in a distributed team.

Machine Learning Engineer needed to join our data science team. Strong skills in Python, PyTorch and MLOps are required. You will train and evaluate models on TensorFlow and deploy them via Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with feature engineering and model monitoring is a big plus.

Ability to collaborate cross-functionally and communicate findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders is essential for this role.
